summary: Iteration 2 end-to-end testing of Razorpay v2 (create-order/verify/webhook), Cloudinary signed-upload signature endpoint, Resend email (mock), and admin product editor modal. Hybrid mock-fallback behaviour validated for all three integrations. Backend pytest 21/21 PASS. Frontend full critical flows PASS including checkout PAY in PREVIEW MODE creating real order, admin product create+edit with mock cloudinary image upload, and all public pages loading.

issues: 'BRAVEST OF THE BRAVE' label text appears outside its tile boundary in the third row before image loads — minor cosmetic, image lazy-loads cover it

passed_tests: GET /api/payments/config returns {key_id:'', is_live:false, currency:'INR'} in preview mock mode
POST /api/payments/create-order returns order_MOCK* id, paise amount = total*100, currency INR, is_mock:true, totals subtotal/discount/gst/shipping_fee/total all present
POST /api/payments/verify with mock signature creates Order (order_number OC*, 5 tracking_steps, payment_status=paid, payment_id echoed); GET /api/orders/track/{n} confirms persistence
POST /api/payments/webhook returns {ok:true} in mock mode (no signature header needed)
GET /api/uploads/signature?folder=products/ as admin returns {is_mock:true, cloud_name:'mock', signature, timestamp, folder}
POST /api/admin/products creates product and appears in /api/products list
PATCH /api/admin/products/{slug} updates fields and GET confirms persistence
Regression: /, /products, /auth/forgot (demo_otp returned in mock), /coupons/check, /orders (legacy), /admin/stats|orders|customers, /newsletter, /contact all pass
Frontend /checkout: PREVIEW MODE label visible next to PAY; full form fill + place-order creates order via /api/payments/verify and navigates to /order-success/OC2606306967
Frontend /admin tabs (tab-overview, tab-orders, tab-products, tab-customers) all rendered with data-testid

Frontend Admin NEW PRODUCT (data-testid='new-product') opens AdminProductEditor modal; fields ed-name/ed-slug/ed-price/ed-stock/ed-desc and save-product all work; mock cloudinary image upload adds picsum placeholder; CREATE closes modal and product appears in list
Frontend Admin edit pencil (data-testid='edit-{slug}') opens editor pre-filled with name+price; updating price and clicking SAVE persists and closes modal
Frontend public pages /, /shop, /new-drop, /best-sellers, /about, /contact, /track-order, /collections all load without console/page errors
action_items: When real keys are added to PRODUCTION env, redeploy — Razorpay (rzp_*), Cloudinary (non-MOCKED CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME) and Resend (non-MOCKED RESEND_API_KEY) will switch to live mode automatically with no code change required. Live signature/webhook verification paths are present in payments.py/uploads.py/emails.py.
Minor cosmetic: BRAVEST OF THE BRAVE label overlap on /collections (pre-image-load only) — low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py verify_payment_signature in mock mode accepts any non-empty payment_id; documented and intentional for preview, but ensure live mode is reached when KEY_ID starts with rzp_ — covered by is_live() check.
uploads.py: ALLOWED_FOLDERS guard correctly rejects arbitrary folder values — good.
emails.py send_* functions are wrapped in try/except at the call sites (server.py) — order creation never blocks on email failure.
server.py /api/payments/webhook accepts JSON payload then inserts to db.webhooks — uses verify_webhook_signature which returns True in mock mode, OK.

Admin product editor: clicking ADD opens native file picker — in mock mode the picsum placeholder is only injected after a file is selected. Consider auto-attaching a placeholder on ADD click in mock mode for nicer DX (very minor).
seed_data_creation: Created test product 'test-iter2-product' and 'test-e2e-pw-*' through admin API and editor modal; created test users TEST_iter2_user. All prefixed with TEST_ for easy identification.
mocked_apis_validated: Razorpay: order_MOCK* ids, mock signature accepted, webhook accepts any payload
Cloudinary: /uploads/signature returns is_mock:true; frontend fallback to picsum.photos placeholder confirmed visually
Resend: send_otp returns demo_otp from /auth/forgot; send_order_confirmation called silently without errors on order creation
context_for_next_testing_agent: All listed features pass. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py is reusable as regression suite. When user redeploys with real keys in PROD, run /api/payments/config and check is_live:true; signed Cloudinary uploads will switch from mock to real automatically.
